explication: Markpad is a cross-platform Markdown reader and editor. A typical workflow opens a document in the tabbed Svelte app, where users can edit it in Monaco or read its rendered preview; frontend commands bridge file operations and rendering to the Tauri/Rust backend. The map also captures sessions and multi-window behavior, settings, and the documented export and rich-rendering capabilities. Connections are limited to relationships visible in excerpts, SOURCE INDEX references, or README statements; several feature implementations were not sampled.
